system-design-review-existing-proposal.after: The proposal is docs/architecture/proposal.md: a browser chat client, a Python ADK service on Cloud Run, a shared document index and an external booking API, with prototype code under app/ and web/. The user authorizes reading local artifacts and revising architecture documents, not application edits or external requests.

system-design-runtime-and-release-review.before: React, OIDC and PostgreSQL are accepted. Per-process session locks and immediate reservation release on browser disconnect are proposed. A gradual SDK rollout will change the session storage format. Only a design review is authorized.
